app.name: Knoblet Macro
help.side-button: Respond to the side button being pressed (on keyup)
help.side-button-double: Respond to the side button being double pressed (on keyup).
help.base-button: Respond to the base button being pressed (on keyup)
help.base-button-double: Respond to the base button being double pressed (on keyup).
help.dead-zone: The angle value change required before registering an angle event
help.key-down-dead-zone: The dead zone that should be applied while a button is being held
help.double-tap-interval:
The max amount of time between presses to register as a double tap (ms).
When double tap is enabled for a button the single press will be delayed from registering until the double tap interval elapses.
help.disable-keyup-on-rotation: When enabled a keyup event will not be registered for a button if the dial angle has been changed while the button was held.
